How Does Prompt Caching Work?

Why caching matters

Prompt caching stores the processed prefix of a prompt so that later requests sharing the same prefix skip recomputing it. This cuts latency and cost for long system prompts, tool definitions and documents that repeat across calls. The cache is keyed on the exact token prefix, so any change early in the prompt invalidates everything after it. Paragraph 0.

The prefix rule

  • Static content goes first
  • Dynamic content goes last
